Card Q&A.a: It means you can look at all of the cards in your security stack, without revealing them to your opponent. You then choose 1 card to add to your hand, and you reveal that card to your opponent.
Card Q&A.q: What does "search your security stack" in this card's [On Play] effect mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] Search your security stack, reveal 1 card from it, and add it to your hand. If it's a yellow card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) Then, shuffle your security stack.
